keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 photorealistic photo of a ripe golden rice paddy in the countryside of Hue, central Vietnam, at golden hour. Close-up of several heavy ripe golden rice panicles bending down in the center of the frame, the rice grains clearly visible. Blurred background: golden rice field, a few green bamboo trees and a distant ancient tiled roof. Warm sunlight from the left. Shallow depth of field. No people. Keep the panicles inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. The rice has been harvested and milled. Show a top-down view of a large round dented aluminum basin filled with clear water, with polished white rice grains soaking at the bottom, sitting in the center of a rustic dark wooden table. Two golden rice panicles lie on the table at the top edge. Same warm golden light from the left. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same basin, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The rice grains and clear water are gone: the basin is now filled with smooth milky white liquid rice batter. At the top edge of the frame, the lower part of a traditional grey stone hand mill is visible, with a thin stream of milky white batter flowing from it into the basin. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same basin, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The stone mill is gone. The liquid batter is gone: in the center of the basin lies one large smooth, soft, pure white ball of rice dough, slightly shiny, with a little white flour dusted around it. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the basin with the dough is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a large pot of boiling water, bubbling and steaming, with many long, thick, round, white rice noodles (bun) swirling in the water. Next to the pot at the right edge, a small round bamboo basket holds coiled cooked thick white noodles. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the noodle pot is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a large dark stockpot of simmering water with big beef bones and thick round slices of pork hock with skin, a layer of grey foam on the surface, and a ladle skimming the foam. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same stockpot, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The foam and the ladle are gone: the broth is now clear and light golden, the beef bones and pork hock still visible. A bundle of thick bruised lemongrass stalks, tied with a string, floats in the broth. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same stockpot, the same bones, the same lemongrass, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The broth is now slightly cloudy and light brown-pink. Next to the pot on the table at the right: a small white bowl of thick purple-grey Hue fermented shrimp paste (mam ruoc), with a spoon. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the stockpot is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a small black frying pan with sizzling deep red oil: finely minced lemongrass, red chili flakes and annatto oil, glossy and bubbling, a little steam. Next to the pan: a few red chilies and lemongrass stalks. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved back to the left: the stockpot is again in the center, the small frying pan now empty at the right edge. The broth in the stockpot is now a deep red-orange color with a glossy layer of red chili oil and specks of lemongrass and chili on the surface, the beef bones and pork hock still visible, steaming. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the stockpot is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a large white ceramic bowl filled with thick round white rice noodles, topped with thin slices of pink rare beef shank, one round slice of pork hock, two pieces of crab cake (cha cua), chopped green onions and cilantro. No broth yet. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same bowl and the same toppings, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera is a little higher and wider. The bowl is now filled with hot deep red-orange broth with glistening red chili oil, steam rising. Around the bowl: a plate of fresh herbs, shredded banana blossom and bean sprouts, lime wedges, sliced red chilies and a pair of wooden chopsticks. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Same bowl of bun bo Hue, same table, same warm light, but now a close-up seen from a low 45-degree side angle. In the center, a pair of wooden chopsticks lifts a bunch of thick round white noodles high above the bowl of deep red spicy broth, broth dripping, steam rising. The herbs and lime are softly blurred behind. Keep the chopsticks and noodles inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.
